name: dumbbell lying on floor hammer press
description: A floor press with palms facing each other, which is kind to your shoulders. It trains the chest and triceps through a short range.
instructions: Lie on the floor with knees bent and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing in.
Start with your upper arms resting on the floor.
Press the dumbbells straight up over your chest.
Pause briefly at the top without locking out hard.
Lower slowly until your triceps touch the floor and repeat.
